readme:
# LTX 2.5 Distilled ComfyUI Video One-Click

## Quick start
1. Create/sign in to Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/join
2. Create a Read token: https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens
3. While signed in to that account, open and accept access terms for each required repository: Lightricks/LTX-2.5, Comfy-Org/gemma-4, and Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Ingredients. Approval is separate for each model/LoRA.
4. In RunPod Settings → Secrets, create `HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN` and paste the token as its value. The template supplies it automatically to model downloads. Keep the token private.
5. Launch this template on an NVIDIA GPU (A100 80 GB recommended). Container disk defaults to 200 GB; use at least 150 GB if changing it. First launch downloads about 108 GiB of models.
6. Wait for the logs to say ComfyUI is ready, then open Connect → HTTP 8188 / ComfyUI. Workflows install automatically.

If the logs report gated access, accept the terms for that exact repository using the same Hugging Face account as your token. This template has no persistent volume; download videos before stopping or replacing the Pod, or configure S3 backup. No terminal commands or manual model downloads are required.
